content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Cloudflare digital

Cloudflare R2 is a scalable object storage solution designed to store and deliver digital products efficiently. Unlike traditional storage options, R2 integrates seamlessly with backend processes, allowing creators to automate product delivery without platform fees. This matters because it empowers creators in regions where common payment platforms charge excessive fees or are unavailable, providing a direct path to revenue with minimal operational costs.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture leverages Cloudflare's global network to deliver content quickly and reliably. By storing files in R2, digital creators can use Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing and product delivery. This means when a customer makes a purchase, the backend logic immediately triggers the delivery of the product, ensuring a seamless experience without the need for complex systems or high fees.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Eliminate platform fees that eat into your profits.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The core components of this solution include Cloudflare R2 for storage, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. Together, they create an efficient pipeline for storing, processing, and delivering digital products. This combination ensures that creators can operate without reliance on traditional payment gateways, enabling them to sell directly to their audience.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure, start by setting up a Cloudflare account and creating an R2 bucket for your digital products. Then, configure the backend using either Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to handle order processing. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for payment processing. This straightforward process allows you to have a fully operational store without any platform restrictions or high fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Maintain full ownership of your products and data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you’re looking to build a sustainable digital product business without the constraints of traditional payment systems, explore our Complete Builder Kit ($197). This resource offers all the blueprints and templates necessary to set up your sovereign digital commerce stack. Visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up Cloudflare R2 for my digital products?

To set up Cloudflare R2, create a Cloudflare account, navigate to the R2 section, and create a new bucket. Once your bucket is created, you can upload your digital products directly for storage and delivery.
What are the advantages of using NOWPayments?

NOWPayments allows you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies with a low 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This means you can sell your products without worrying about high transaction costs or payment restrictions.
Can I automate product delivery with this setup?

Yes, using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products. This ensures that customers receive their purchases immediately upon successful payment confirmation.
What if I have more than five products?
If you have more than five products, you can easily scale your Cloudflare R2 setup by simply adding more files to your bucket and updating your backend logic to handle additional products.
How do I ensure my files are secure?

Cloudflare R2 provides built-in security features. By configuring access settings and using secure links for file delivery, you can ensure that your digital products are protected from unauthorized access.
